title: How do humans perceive adversarial text? A reality check on the validity and naturalness of word-based adversarial attacks
method: Word-based adversarial attacks (CHARACTERSUGAR, HotFlip, TextFooler) on sentiment classifiers
replication_gap: Last local replication reached 100% ASR on trivial synthetic sentiment data, failing to reproduce the authors' realistic 76.5-94.7% ASR. Fine-tuning target: a tool-using agent that produces adversarial perturbations with model ASR >= the authors' realistic numbers on harder, more realistic data.
notes: attack_success_rate/success_rate = HotFlip IMDB (best author ASR); accuracy = mean of the 6 reported ASRs (0.856).
